name: Pray for FCF Pastors and Leaders

prayers.title: Council of Elders
prayers.details:
Bro. Ernie, Pastor Felix, Pastor William, Bro. Romeo, Bro. Mer, Bro. Arnold, Pastor Ian, Pastor Janjan, Pastor Livi

Pray that they would:
1. Love the Lord with all my/their heart, mind, soul, and strength
2. Experience the filling and anointing of the Holy Spirit
3. Honor Christ in his heart, words, and actions
4. Be a loving, faithful, Christ-like husband to his wife
5. Lead his family and the church with wisdom, courage, and sensitivity that only the Holy Spirit can provide
6. Abide in Christ and be devoted to prayer, relying on God
7. Rightly divide the Word of Truth, and communicate it clearly
8. Have a heart for the lost and be an effective sharer of God's Word to the lost
9. Keep his priorities in line with the will of God
10. Walk in purity and be protected from the deceptive schemes of Satan
11. Create an atmosphere of unity and shared vision for the will of God with the local church
12. Be a good listener, open to reason, and discerning to God's truth in a situation
13. Love peace and not be quarrelsome
14. Be free from pleasing people and showing favoritism
15. Continue to discover new depths of understanding as a student of God's Word
16. Experience good health, rest, and refreshment in the Lord
17. Share the grace, strength and compassion of the Good Shepherd toward all those he leads.
18. Exhibit love, comfort, and encouragement as he performs weddings, funerals, counseling, etc.

name: Pray for Yourself, Christian Friends & Family

prayers.title: Myself, Christian friends & family
prayers.details:
Ask God to bring to mind those fellow believers that are friends or family.

Pray that they would:
1. Love the Lord with all my/their heart, mind, soul, and strength
2. Fully surrender my/their lives to the lordship of Jesus Christ
3. Be baptized, stay in fellowship, service, worship, and growth in a Bible-teaching church
4. Abide in Christ, be filled with His Spirit, and live according to His will
5. Walk in love, kindness, and favor with the people around me/them
6. Find my/their identity and satisfaction in Christ rather than anything else
7. Know and experience the hope, riches, and power of being a child of God
8. Be devoted in prayer, both personally and corporately
9. Repent of daily sins and walk in holiness before God
10. Break free from any bondage, bad habits, or addictions in my/their lives
11. Walk in integrity, keep my/their promises, and fulfill commitments
12. Live with Christ as the hope and true source of peace and happiness
13. Share the gospel and faithfully make disciples of others

prayers.title: Messenger
prayers.details: Pray for dependence on God, wisdom, anointing & words of utterance even as he prepares the message; boldness by the power of the Holy Spirit; humility, pure heart; good health, protection - mind & heart

prayers.title: Praise and Worship
prayers.details: Pray for the worship leader to have a prepared heart during practice and on Sunday, that he will be able to lead the whole Praise & Worship Team into a life changing worship; to be united and empowered by the Holy Spirit to lead the congregation into a God-centered worship.

prayers.title: Attendees
prayers.details: Pray that they will prepare their hearts for worship before coming to the church; a receptive heart for the word of God to change them; to enjoy the fellowship and will hunger for the truth.

prayers.title: All FCF ministries
prayers.details:
Pray that:
1. The ministry heads would be sensitive to the Lord and His leading as to how these ministries should be carried out.
2. The Lord's will would prevail to carry out the purpose of the gospel and Christian growth in the local body of Christ.
3. The Lord would supply the provisions and needs for each ministry.

prayers.title: Food Committee – (Pray for a Ministry Head)
Church Planting – (Pray for a Ministry Head)
Campus Ministry – (Pray for a Ministry Head)
Non-Christians / new Christians
prayers.details:
That God would:
1. Connect them to genuine believers and the gospel
2. Disconnect them from influence that are pulling them away from Christ
3. Expose the lies they've believed that have kept them from Christ
4. Show mercy, bind Satan, and turn them from darkness to light
5. Enlighten them to everything God extends toward those who believe
6. Convict them of sin and their need for a Savior
7. After salvation, help them be baptized and find a Bible-teaching church
8. Grow them in Christ by helping them obey the Word of God as a disciple
9. Help them live with Christ as their hope and true source of happiness
10. Deliver them from evil, the devil's traps and schemes, and any strongholds
11. Help them abide in Christ and live according to His will

name: Pray for Pastors & Missionaries Around the World

prayers.title: Pastors & missionaries around the world
prayers.details:
That they:
1. See and seize God-given opportunities to share the Gospel.
2. Experience God's grace increasing in their lives and work.
3. Be protected from Satan and those who might wish to harm them.
4. See and seek God-glorifying results & experience good emotional, spiritual, physical health.
5. Have healthy relationships with their families, missionaries, and national colleagues.
6. Show the fruits of the Spirit. Reflect integrity and holiness.
7. Be a loving, faithful, Christ-like husband to his wife & lead his family
8. Experience good health, rest, and refreshment in the Lord
9. Pray for more workers and the resources to sustain them. Ask God to move mightily among the nations.

prayers.title: Ep Barajan – (still preparing for the next assignment)
Missionary partners
prayers.details: CCI, CPMT, ACM, PSALM, GIDEONS International

name: Pray for Partner Churches and Outreaches

prayers.title: Partner churches and outreaches
prayers.details:
1. Protection for the pastor(s) for each local church
2. Provision for the churches
3. Unity in the local churches
4. Strengthening of the local churches so they can start churches in another area
5. Full time church planter for FCF Outreaches
6. Team volunteers to establish Bible Studies and fellowships in the outreaches
7. God-glorifying testimony within the outreach area
8. Peace/cooperation with the local leaders within the outreach area.

prayers.title: San Jose, Talibon – Pastor Deodato Auxtero

name: Pray for World, National, Local Concerns

prayers.title: Governmental authorities
prayers.details:
That they would:
1. Submit to the authority and ways of God and His Word
2. Come to the knowledge of Christ and surrender to His lordship
3. Lead with honor, respect, wisdom, compassion and godliness
4. Use good judgment, pursue justice, love mercy and walk humbly in God
5. Watch over, protect, lead, and serve those in their care
6. Respect all people without regard to gender, race, religion, or social status
7. Hate evil, pride, injustice, and turn away from Satan's lies and schemes
8. Establish rules and laws that honor God's law and strengthens families and city
9. Reward those who do right and punish those who do wrong
10. Refuse to take a bribe or allow favouritism in judgment
11. Become hard workers for faithfully fulfil their duties
12. Make choices based upon the fear of God, and not the fear of man

prayers.title: World
prayers.details:
1. Pray for Israel – salvation of the Jews; pray for peace in the country.
2. Pray for protection from terrorism; terrorism victims, law enforcement agencies protecting terrorism activities
3. Pray for recovery of countries who encountered natural disasters.
4. Pray for revival of Christians around the world & infiltration of God's Word.
5. Pray for the urgency to preach the Gospel especially in the midst of wars and troubles.

prayers.title: National
prayers.details:
Pray for:
1. The Lord would bless your city/country and make it a safe and prosperous place for families to freely live, grow, and worship Him in their lives
2. Raise up strong pastors and healthy churches throughout the city/country:
   • will rely on the sufficiency of Scripture.
   • will be faithful to preach the Gospel of Christ.
   • will love one another and not be divided
   • will be a praying church
   • will be a light and spiritual force for good
3. Unite local pastors in prayer for one another, revival of the church, spiritual awakening to the city/country.
4. Open the eyes of believers with hearts of love and compassion for the lost
5. Replace corrupt, poor performance government leaders with strong, godly leaders who will honour God and serve people wisely, justly, and unselfishly.
6. Shut down corrupt businesses and organizations that are destroying the community with sinful products or practices
7. Bring in strong, healthy businesses that will benefit families and the city
8. Replace corrupt laws and standards with just and godly ones
9. Strengthen the marriages, parenting, and families in the city
10. Strengthen the law enforcement to protect the people and eliminate crime
11. Government sectors - BIR, GSIS, DepEd, DOH, DPWH, PNP, AFP, DAR, NIA, DENR, etc.
12. The Lord to destroy the stronghold of corruption, religion, lesbianism, perversion, drug problem, human trafficking and other forms of criminalities.
13. The Lord to spare the Philippines from natural calamities & to sustain economic growth nation wide
14. Pour out His Spirit and rebuke satanic influences that control the city

prayers.title: For Husbands
prayers.details:
That he would:
• Love the Lord with all his heart, mind, soul, and strength
• Read the Word of God and allow it to guide his decisions
• Depend upon God's wisdom and strength rather than his own
• Walk in integrity, keep his promises, and fulfill his commitments
• Love his wife unconditionally and stay faithful (mentally/sexually) to her
• Be patient, kind, hard to offend, and quick to forgive
• Not be passive, but embrace his God-given responsibilities
• Be a hard worker who faithfully provides for his family
• Be surrounded with wise friends and avoid foolish friends
• Become a strong, spiritual leader with courage, wisdom, and conviction
• Break free from any bondage, bad habits that are holding him back
• Use good judgment, love mercy, and walk humbly with God
• Make choices based upon the fear of God, not the fear of man

prayers.title: For Wives
prayers.details:
That she would:
• Love the Lord with all his heart, mind, soul, and strength
• Find her beauty and identity in Christ and reflect His character
• Love the Word of God and allow it to grow her into Christlikeness
• Be gracious, speaking truth in love and avoiding gossip
• Respect her husband and submit to his leadership as unto the Lord
• Be grateful and find contentment in Christ, not circumstances
• Be hospitable and diligently serve others with Christ-like joy
• Bring her family good and not evil all the days of her life
• Seek advice and encouragement from older, godly women
• Not believe lies that would devalue her roles as a wife and mother
• Be patient, kind, hard to offend, and quick to forgive
• Stay faithful (mentally/sexually) to her husband, also his needs
• Guide her home and children in diligent, Christ-like ways
• Walk in integrity, providing no reason for slander against her

prayers.title: For Children
prayers.details:
That they would:
• Love the Lord with all his heart, mind, soul, and strength
• Come to know and have a personal relationship with Christ early on in life
• Develop dislike for evil, pride, hypocrisy, and sin
• Be protected from evil in each area of their lives: spiritually, emotionally, mentally, and physically
• Be caught when they are guilty and receive the discipline of the Lord
• Receive wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and discretion from the Lord and apply such wisdom in decision making
• Respect and submit to those in authority
• Be surrounded by the right kinds of friends and avoid wrong friends
• Find a godly mate and raise godly children who will follow Christ
• Walk in sexual and moral purity throughout their lives
• Keep a clear conscience before the Lord
• Not fear evil or world's view, but walk in the fear of the Lord
• Be a blessing to their family, the church, and the cause of Christ
• Be filled with the knowledge of God's will and fruitful in every good work.
• Be patient, kind, hard to offend, and quick to forgive
